Graduation Project

2025 - 2026

Haden

AI Companion for Adopted Children

Haden is an AI-powered platform designed to support adopted children through interactive sessions with a virtual character. The character communicates naturally with children, helping uncover feelings, concerns, or experiences they may find difficult to express directly. By analyzing the child's conversations, emotions, and facial expressions, the system generates intelligent reports that help social workers better understand the child's emotional well-being, identify potential signs of distress or mistreatment, and provide early support when needed.

Team: 4 Members · My Role: AI Developer, Virtual Character Creation & Code Integration, Facial Emotion Dataset Collection & Preparation.

Mousa Platform

AI-Powered Municipal Services Platform

An AI-powered platform designed to make incident reporting and citizen support easier and faster. Developed as part of a cooperative training team project, it includes three connected platforms: Mousa (main platform), Moeen (support), and Munabbih (alerts). The system uses NLP and predictive models to analyze complaints, validate information, identify urgent cases, and support better decision-making.

NLP · 2025

University Information Chatbot

An enhanced university information chatbot designed to help students quickly find answers to frequently asked questions, such as scholarship payment dates, admission and registration periods, and other university-related inquiries. The project enhances the existing university chatbot using web scraping, data collection and processing, and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to improve information retrieval and provide relevant, accurate responses.

FINALIST · 2025

Ayah

✦Hackathon

Ayah is an AI-powered virtual banking assistant designed to make financial services more accessible to elderly individuals and people with limited digital literacy. Through natural voice conversations and a dedicated smart device, users can interact with a virtual character to request banking services, such as money transfers, without navigating complex banking applications. The project aims to simplify everyday banking by providing an intuitive, user-friendly experience from the comfort of home.
